paper.title: Socratic-Zero : Bootstrapping Reasoning via Data-Free Agent Co-evolution
paper.central_claim: Socratic-Zero co-evolves a Solver (DPO-trained), a fixed Teacher (verifier and problem refiner) and a Generator (value-weighted SFT distillation of the Teacher) from 100 seed questions; Socratic-Solver-8B gains +20.2 points over prior synthesis baselines and Generator-32B data trains student models competitively with commercial LLMs.
